title: MoreMetals MITE
description: More metal and its equipment tools are added to give players more choices.
body:
## What is added to this mod? 
- Seven sets of equipment and tools have been added to give players more equipment options.
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/edc386f49ff93a74c635c70f9829a9711e99247e.png)
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d2d268f1bc13623295f149e97f659aa0f3e96da4.png)
## What are the functions of these equipment?
- equipment represented by titanium alloy sets, equipment with high armor value and anti-Schreim corrosion characteristics but low upper limit of enchantment. 
- For the equipment represented by Midas gold, the armor value is low but the upper limit of the demon is high. Wearing a complete set will also give players some buff. 
## How to obtain these ore?
- The Overworld will generate tin ore.
- The Underworld will generate manganese ore, aluminum ore, titanium ore, and Admantium alloy ore.
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62294ecbc6d4b53e40f6a6c91f8fa081e734b522.png)
- The nether will generate platinum ore, Midas gold mine. 
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2841c94550d71574d40eb61584c685afdbcd0c64.png)
- Bronze is synthesized by copper ingot and tin ingot. 
- Iron and manganese are synthesized for steel. 
- Titanium alloy is synthesized from titanium and aluminum. 
- Rose gold is synthesized from copper and gold. 
- Adamantium alloy equipment is synthesized from Adamantium and Adamantium alloys and corresponding ancient metal equipment. 
## Extra
- There are Adamantium alloy equipment to replace the original Adamantium equipment.
